title: Canonical coefficient maps for the diagonal and normal section invariants
statement: Let $P$, $1\le m\le n$, and the lifted quotient $\phi$ be as in [def-pur-finite-orientation-scalar-presentation]. For a smooth separated $f:X\to Y$ of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, use the actual dualizing, diagonal-section and associated-graded normal-section presentations in [lem-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-normalization]. Define $q_\omega$ by transporting the ordinary reduced exceptional counit map, followed by the scalar-unit comparison, through the specified dualizing presentations. Define $q_C$ and $q_N$ by transporting the ordinary section coefficient map of [def-pur-dnc-coefficient-section-maps]: the scalar/pullback mate followed by pullback of the same exceptional coefficient map. The normal section is that of the actual diagonal normal cone, not an independently chosen bundle. Define $v$ to be chartDiagonalBeta with the published projective-line root transport; thus $v$ is zero-section restriction of the integration-normalized bundle factor. All compactifications and finiteness instances needed in these definitions are derived from the stated geometry.
